items.title: My partner of 17 years left me his $1 million home. His children are crying foul. Am I obliged to split it with them?
items.content: “I never paid rent, although I put about $45,000 toward a new kitchen and a roof.”

items.title: ‘I don’t feel sorry for myself’: I’m 64 and will be renting for the rest of my life. Is that so bad?
items.content: “I married a wonderful man with a good income. He left his job due to health issues and suffered a massive stroke at 53.”

items.title: CoreWeave set off a wave of anxiety — but Wall Street’s dire prognosis is premature
items.content: Stop listening to market pundits and start looking at market performance.

items.title: The U.S. stock market is fracturing into two camps, and it’s leaving investors with a brutal case of whiplash
items.content: The artificial-intelligence trade is on the ropes. CNN’s “Fear & Greed” index is screaming fear, and the yield on the 10-year Treasury note just clinched its biggest daily drop since the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank.

items.title: Treasury yields log biggest drop since the 2023 banking crisis. Here’s what’s going on.
items.content: ‘It’s a take-back trade,’ says PGIM’s Tipp. ‘Not an all-out fear of recession type of situation.’

items.title: Americans are having fewer babies — and pampering them with luxury diapers
items.content: “Fewer babies in each household means parents spend more per baby,” Procter & Gamble’s CFO says.

items.title: 3 big reasons Micron and other chip stocks fell hard on Thursday
items.content: Investors are spooked by Tesla’s lower spending target, Lam Research’s weaker-than-expected forecast and a fresh reminder that the AI boom relies on outside funding.

items.title: Oil prices approach Iran-war highs as soaring tanker rates trigger a second energy squeeze
items.content: Wall Street may be starting to price in the scenario everyone fears: a full-scale regional conflict that could further choke off global energy supplies and unleash a fresh wave of turmoil across financial markets.

items.title: Moderna’s cancer vaccine hits its targets, but a data leak rattled investors and the stock tumbled
items.content: A ‘sell-the-news reaction’? The experimental treatment helped prevent the return of cancer or death in melanoma patients by 42% after two years.

items.title: Is getting a wedding band from Quince a bad idea? It’s a third of the price of a local jeweler.
items.content: “I am slightly anxious about purchasing something so big” from an online retailer known for cut-price duplicates of popular clothes and accessories.
